description: Presidential Secretariat - Order Published under public Security Ordinance was approved by the Parliament on 31.07.2019
reasoning: This gazette content announces the parliamentary approval of a proclamation under the Public Security Ordinance (Chapter 40), which is a legal/regulatory matter. It deals with the implementation of statutory provisions (Part II of the Ordinance) rather than government personnel changes, structural changes, or any of the other specialized categories. The content focuses on the legal framework and regulatory authority under existing legislation.
